candidates.purpose: Polygon/Massive WebSocket stock scanner with sliding-window state, RVOL filters, market context and MFE/MAE outcome tracking
candidates.latencySuitability: HIGH if Polygon/Massive entitlement is available; 1-minute bar architecture is insufficient for trades-per-minute/order-flow without extension
candidates.license: MIT declared in package.json; GitHub repository metadata did not expose a recognized license file
candidates.securityNotes: Requires POLYGON_API_KEY via environment. Small dependency surface (dotenv/express/ws). No evidence in inspected package metadata of automated test scripts; repository last push observed 2025-12-21, so maintenance freshness is weak for production adoption.
candidates.lookAheadRisk: Historical backfill and outcome analytics must preserve event-time boundaries; do not let backfilled bars enter point-in-time scoring.
borrowPatterns: MFE/MAE outcome tracking with context tags

promotionRule: No production dependency. Any borrowed component must be reproduced in a challenger and benchmarked point-in-time against TAGX baseline before promotion.
